questions.q: The 'Indus Water Treaty' remains a point of diplomatic discussion between India and which country?
questions.explain: This treaty has been around for decades. It manages how we share the water of the Indus river system, and it’s a constant subject of diplomatic talks between us and Pakistan.

questions.q: Which space agency is collaborating with India for the 'NISAR' satellite mission, which is ready for launch?

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Indian Army celebrated its 78th Army Day on January 15, 2026. Which of the following commands hosted the main parade this year?
questions.explain: The 78th Army Day parade was held on 15 January 2026 at Mahal Road in Jaipur, hosted by the South Western Command. It was the fourth time the parade was held outside Delhi and the first time outside a military cantonment.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: On 15 January 2026, which organisation celebrated its 151st Foundation Day, during which the government announced the deployment of 200 Automatic Weather Stations across major cities?
questions.explain: The India Meteorological Department marked its 151st Foundation Day on 15 January 2026 at Mausam Bhawan, New Delhi. Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh announced the rollout of 200 Automatic Weather Stations to strengthen urban weather observation.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: India assumed the Chairship of which grouping for 2026, with its presidency logo unveiled by External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar in January 2026?
questions.explain: India took over the BRICS Chairship for 2026. The official logo was launched by EAM S. Jaishankar, with India's theme focused on resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability.

questions.q: India and __________ signed a 'Strategic Space Partnership' this week to collaborate on deep-space exploration and lunar landing technologies.

questions.q: In January 2026, the Bharat Gaurav Deluxe AC Tourist Train launched two new heritage circuits from Delhi covering which two states?
questions.explain: The 'Garvi Gujarat' and 'Padharo Rajasthan' circuits of the Bharat Gaurav Deluxe AC Tourist Train began from Delhi in January 2026, covering heritage sites across Gujarat and Rajasthan.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: NITI Aayog, through the Atal Innovation Mission, launched India's first State Innovation Mission (SIM) in which state in 2026?

questions.q: The 2026 Men's FIH Hockey World Cup will be co-hosted by which two countries?

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: How many Padma Awards did President Droupadi Murmu approve for conferment in 2026 (announced on the eve of Republic Day)?

questions.q: Who was selected for the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2025, announced in January 2026?

questions.q: The second edition of the Global Buddhist Summit 2026 was held at which venue in New Delhi?

questions.q: In 2026, India concluded a landmark Free Trade Agreement with which partner, expected to apply provisionally later in the year?

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which country's Foreign Minister, Toshimitsu Motegi, made an official visit to India in January 2026?
questions.explain: Japan's Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi undertook a three-day official visit to India from 15 to 17 January 2026, reflecting the strong India-Japan strategic partnership.

questions.q: In January 2026, Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the third International Kite Festival at Baansera Park in which city?
questions.explain: Amit Shah inaugurated the third International Kite Festival at Baansera Park in New Delhi on 16 January 2026, calling for Delhi to be developed as a national hub for kite celebrations.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Who is the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of India?
questions.explain: General Anil Chauhan is India's second and current Chief of Defence Staff. General Bipin Rawat was the first CDS, while General Upendra Dwivedi serves as the Chief of the Army Staff.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which Indian state has launched the 'Mukhya Mantri Khel Protsahan Yojana' to provide scholarships to budding athletes?
questions.explain: The Delhi government launched the Mukhyamantri Khel Protsahan Yojana to support sportspersons, offering up to Rs 5 lakh a year to school-level athletes and up to Rs 20 lakh to elite athletes for coaching, equipment, travel and nutrition.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: In the context of India's development plans, what does the term 'Blue Economy' primarily refer to?
options: Sustainable use of ocean resources for growth
questions.explain: A 'Blue Economy' isn't just about fishing; it's about making sure our ocean resources boost our economy without destroying the marine environment. It's a balancing act we're trying to master.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Market Access Support (MAS) Scheme, with an outlay of about Rs 4,531 crore, was launched by the Government of India in 2026 primarily to support what?
options: Participation of exporters in international trade fairs and exhibitions
questions.explain: The Market Access Support Scheme supports Indian exporters' participation in international trade fairs, exhibitions and trade delegations, with a strong focus on MSME participation, to boost exports.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which wildlife sanctuary in India reported a record increase in the population of 'Barasingha' (Swamp Deer) this season?
questions.explain: Dudhwa is the pride of Uttar Pradesh! Seeing the Barasingha population climb is a massive success story for our conservation efforts. It shows that when you protect the habitat, the wildlife really does flourish.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Viksit Bharat@2047 is the Government of India's vision to make the country a developed nation by which year, marking 100 years of independence?

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: India recently signed a major maritime security agreement with which Southeast Asian nation to counter piracy in the Malacca Strait?
questions.explain: We've strengthened our ties with Indonesia. Given how busy that trade route is, this pact is a big deal for keeping our cargo ships safe from regional threats.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Who won the men's singles title at the 2026 Australian Open, completing his career Grand Slam in the process?
questions.explain: Carlos Alcaraz defeated Novak Djokovic in the final to win his first Australian Open title, becoming the youngest man to complete the career Grand Slam in singles.

questions.q: In which year did the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) launch the pilot for the Digital Rupee (e-Rupee / CBDC)?
questions.explain: The RBI launched its wholesale Digital Rupee (e-Rupee/CBDC) pilot on 1 November 2022 and the retail pilot on 1 December 2022, making 2022 the launch year for both segments.

questions.q: ISRO's Venus Orbiter Mission (also called Shukrayaan) is scheduled to be launched in which year?

questions.q: The V.O. Chidambaranar (VOC) Port, being developed as India's first Green Hydrogen Hub Port, is located in which state?
questions.explain: The V.O. Chidambaranar Port at Thoothukudi in Tamil Nadu is being developed as India's first Green Hydrogen Hub Port and was recognised as a green hydrogen hub under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Who is the current chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) of India?
questions.explain: Former Supreme Court judge Justice V. Ramasubramanian was appointed NHRC Chairperson and took charge in December 2024, filling the post that heads India's apex human rights body.

questions.q: Global inflation concerns resurfaced this month after the World Bank released its latest report. What is the predicted growth rate for the Indian economy for FY 2026-27?

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar 2025 was announced for young writers in how many Indian languages?

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The United Nations has declared 2026 as the International Year of which of the following?

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: What is the primary focus of the newly launched 'Bharat 6G Alliance'?
questions.explain: Before we can roll out 6G, we need to agree on standards. This alliance is basically bringing all our researchers and industry experts under one roof to decide how India's 6G should actually work.

questions.q: Which national park in Madhya Pradesh was notified as India's 58th Tiger Reserve?
questions.explain: Madhav National Park in Shivpuri, Madhya Pradesh, was notified as India's 58th Tiger Reserve in 2025, helping reconnect the tiger corridor between Ranthambore and central India.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: In which year was the Smart Cities Mission launched by the Government of India?

questions.q: Which country hosted and conceptualised the Voice of Global South Summit (VOGSS) series, including the first edition in January 2023?

questions.q: The PM Vishwakarma Yojana covers 18 traditional trades. Which of the following is NOT one of them?

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The recent 'Exercise Desert Knight' was held between India and which two countries?
questions.explain: This is a really high-profile joint exercise. By bringing the UAE and France together with us, we're really boosting our tactical cooperation in the Middle East region.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which Indian state has become the first to achieve 100% saturation in the 'Jal Jeevan Mission' for all rural households?
questions.explain: Goa became the first state in India to provide 100% tap water connections to all rural households under the Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal), achieving the milestone in 2020.

questions.q: The Saraswati Samman 2025 was awarded to Ramkumar Mukhopadhyay for his novel 'Hara Parbati Katha'. The work is written in which language?
questions.explain: Bengali author Ramkumar Mukhopadhyay was chosen for the Saraswati Samman 2025 for his novel 'Hara Parbati Katha'. The award carries a cash prize of Rs 15 lakh.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which tech giant announced a US$17.5 billion investment in India's cloud and AI infrastructure for 2026-2029, its largest in Asia?

questions.q: Prime Minister Narendra Modi flagged off India's first Vande Bharat Sleeper train in January 2026. Which two cities does this train connect?

questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Padma Awards 2026 were announced in January. Which Indian cricket captain was conferred the Padma Shri for leading India to the T20 World Cup and Champions Trophy titles?

questions.q: India’s latest deep-sea mission, 'Samudrayaan', is set to deploy its manned submersible 'Matsya 6000'. Who is the nodal agency handling this project?

questions.q: In the latest IMF report released this January, what is India’s projected GDP growth rate for the financial year 2026-27?
questions.explain: In its January 2026 World Economic Outlook update, the IMF projected India's GDP growth for 2026-27 (FY27) at 6.5%, having raised the figure on the back of strong domestic demand, while keeping India the fastest-growing major economy.

questions.q: At the World Economic Forum in Davos in January 2026, India announced green hydrogen cooperation agreements with several nations. Which Gulf country was among them?
questions.explain: At Davos 2026, India announced green hydrogen cooperation agreements with countries including Oman, Belgium, Kuwait, Jordan, Paraguay and Zimbabwe, building on frameworks such as the India-Oman Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement to advance electrolyser technology and hydrogen hubs.

questions.q: The RBI has introduced a new framework for 'Digital Lending Transparency'. What is the primary requirement for lenders under these new norms?

questions.q: The 'Indra 2025' joint military exercise was held in Rajasthan in October 2025 between India and which country?

questions.q: The 'PM-VANI' scheme, which has seen renewed emphasis this month, is aimed at what?
questions.explain: If you've noticed more public Wi-Fi hotspots popping up in your neighborhood lately, that's PM-VANI in action. The goal is simple: affordable internet access for every corner of the country.

questions.q: ISRO's Venus Orbiter Mission, popularly called Shukrayaan, was approved by the government. In which year is it scheduled to launch?
questions.explain: The Venus Orbiter Mission (Shukrayaan) was approved in September 2024 with a planned launch in March 2028. It will study Venus's surface and atmosphere, carrying international instruments including a payload contributed by Sweden.

questions.q: The second edition of the Global Buddhist Summit was held in January 2026. At which New Delhi venue did it take place?
questions.explain: The International Buddhist Confederation, with the Ministry of Culture, organised the second Global Buddhist Summit on 24-25 January 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.

questions.q: India's first Vande Bharat Metro (later renamed Namo Bharat Rapid Rail) service runs on which route?

questions.explain: The United States assumed the G20 presidency on 1 December 2025 and is hosting the 2026 G20 Summit, planned in Miami (Doral, Florida) in December 2026. South Africa had hosted the 2025 edition.

questions.explain: The 78th Army Day parade was held on Mahal Road in Jaipur, Rajasthan, the first time the parade was taken out of a military cantonment onto a public urban route. The 2026 theme was 'Year of Networking and Data Centricity'.

questions.q: India's first 'Green Port' project was recently completed at which location?

questions.q: The sixth edition of the Khelo India Winter Games 2026 was held in January 2026. At which two locations were the events staged?

questions.q: The 'Kavach' system, which is in the news again, is related to which domain?
questions.explain: Oh, Kavach is crucial! It's our indigenous automatic train protection system. We're seeing it being rolled out much faster now on all major high-density routes to prevent collisions.

questions.q: The Union Government has recently expanded the scope of the 'PM-Surya Ghar' scheme. Which primary goal does this expansion focus on?

questions.q: Which nation officially took over the Chairmanship (Presidency) of the G20 for the 2026 cycle?
questions.explain: The United States assumed the G20 Presidency on 1 December 2025, taking over from South Africa (which held the 2025 cycle). The US will host the G20 Leaders' Summit in Miami in December 2026.

questions.explain: NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) is a joint mission of ISRO and NASA. Launched on 30 July 2025, it began its science operations in early January 2026, mapping subtle land shifts, landslides and coastal erosion.

questions.q: The RBI has tightened norms for 'Digital Lending Apps' to protect consumer privacy. What is the main mandate for these companies?
questions.explain: Data security is the priority now. The RBI wants to make sure that if these apps are dealing with Indian customers, the data must stay right here on our own servers to prevent misuse.

questions.q: The 10th edition of the Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP 2026), released in January 2026, lays down official quality standards for what?
questions.explain: The Indian Pharmacopoeia is the official book of standards for drugs and medicines manufactured and sold in India. Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda released its 10th edition (IP 2026) on 2 January 2026.

questions.q: Under what theme did the World Economic Forum's 56th Annual Meeting take place at Davos in January 2026?
questions.explain: The 56th WEF Annual Meeting (19-23 January 2026) was held under the theme 'A Spirit of Dialogue'. 'Rebuilding Trust' (2024), 'Cooperation in a Fragmented World' (2023) and 'The Great Reset' (2021) were earlier WEF themes.

questions.q: In 2024, the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology was subsumed into which newly established national science award scheme?

questions.q: Which country recently became the first to successfully test a hydrogen-powered cargo ship for international trade?
questions.explain: Norway is leading the way in marine decarbonization. It's tough to power huge cargo ships with clean fuel, but they've managed to prove that hydrogen is a viable future.

questions.q: The 'Right to Disconnect' Bill, which lets employees ignore work communication outside office hours, was introduced in the Lok Sabha in December 2025 by which MP?

questions.q: India's first Vande Metro service, since renamed the 'Namo Bharat Rapid Rail', connects which two cities?
questions.explain: India's first Vande Metro runs between Ahmedabad and Bhuj in Gujarat, covering about 360 km. On its inauguration in September 2024 it was renamed the 'Namo Bharat Rapid Rail'.

questions.q: Which international organization recently released the 'World Employment and Social Outlook' report for 2026?
questions.explain: The International Labour Organization (ILO) is the go-to source for job market data. Their latest report gives us a sobering look at how global job trends are shifting right now.

questions.explain: Indra is a long-standing tradition between India and Russia. They train together to make sure both navies are on the same page when it comes to maritime security.

questions.q: Palli, recognised as India's first 'carbon-neutral panchayat', is located in which Union Territory?

questions.q: The first 'Voice of Global South Summit', which gives a platform to the concerns of developing nations, was hosted in January 2023 by which country?
questions.explain: India hosted the first Voice of Global South Summit on 12-13 January 2023 under the theme 'Unity of Voice, Unity of Purpose', aiming to amplify the priorities of developing countries on the world stage.

questions.q: Which company is building India's first semiconductor wafer fabrication (fab) plant at Dholera, Gujarat?

questions.q: The 'Kavach' system, India's anti-collision technology, is being fast-tracked for installation on which type of routes?
questions.explain: Safety first! The railways are focusing on the busiest routes where thousands of people travel daily to make sure the anti-collision tech is active everywhere it's needed most.

questions.q: What is the primary objective of the 'Mission Antyodaya' survey conducted this year?

questions.q: In January 2026, the PANKHUDI portal was launched to facilitate CSR partnerships for women and child welfare projects. Which ministry launched it?
options: Ministry of Women and Child Development
questions.explain: The Ministry of Women and Child Development launched the PANKHUDI portal on 9 January 2026 as a digital platform to channel Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) funds transparently into women and child welfare projects.

questions.q: India's first commercial deep-sea mining mission, 'Samudrayaan-II', is set to deploy the MATSYA 6000 vessel. Which organization is leading this mission?

questions.q: Who is the chairperson of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) as of January 2026?
questions.explain: Tuhin Kanta Pandey, a 1987-batch IAS officer, took charge as the 11th SEBI Chairman on 1 March 2025, succeeding Madhabi Puri Buch, and continues in the role through January 2026.

questions.q: PM Narendra Modi performed the Bhoomi Pujan of the Rs 6,950 crore Kaziranga Elevated Corridor Project in January 2026. In which state is it located?
questions.explain: The 86-km Kaziranga Elevated Corridor (Kaliabor-Numaligarh section of NH-715) is in Assam. It includes an elevated wildlife corridor allowing rhinos, elephants and tigers to move freely beneath the roadway.

questions.q: The trilateral coast guard exercise 'Dosti-17' held in early 2026 involved India, Sri Lanka and which third country?
questions.explain: Dosti is a long-running trilateral coast guard exercise between India, Sri Lanka and the Maldives, aimed at strengthening maritime cooperation and security in the Indian Ocean Region.

questions.q: Which state emerged as the overall champion of the 2nd Khelo India Beach Games 2026 held at Diu?

questions.q: In January 2026, NITI Aayog released a report recommending the convergence of centrally administered schemes for which sector?

questions.q: India and Israel signed a Joint Declaration of Intent in January 2026 to deepen cooperation in which sector?

questions.q: The National Sports Governance Act, 2025, which came into effect on 1 January 2026, provides for the creation of which body?

questions.q: In January 2026, the government announced the deployment of 200 Automatic Weather Stations (AWS) across how many major metropolitan cities?

questions.q: The 78th Army Day parade was held in which city on 15 January 2026?

questions.q: ISRO's upcoming Chandrayaan-4 mission, approved by the Union Cabinet, is primarily designed to demonstrate which capability?
options: Sample return from the Moon to Earth
questions.explain: Chandrayaan-4 is planned as India's first lunar sample-return mission. Its goal is to land on the Moon, collect regolith samples and bring them safely back to Earth, using multiple LVM-3 launches and in-orbit docking.
